Hi Ari / Megan — great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (high level)
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for Medicore's batch summarization + nearline clinical search workloads.
- Constraints: must support EU patient data residency for training-derived artifacts; production latency SLOs ~ <120ms P95 for short requests; expected peak concurrency ~ 40 qps.
- Success criteria for trial: end-to-end demo of ingest -> embeddings -> rerank with 1–2 sample datasets and a simple SLAs checklist.

Next step proposal
1) Book a 90-minute technical deep dive (runtime & integration) with your engineering and infra lead.
2) Because your team spans US / EU / APAC, propose a rotating week-of-day 'time-baton' schedule so no single region gets locked into inconvenient hours across the pilot. I attached a small ICS with three candidate slots per region.

Suggested rotation pattern (short bullets here — full table in attached ICS)
- Week A: US-friendly slot (08:00–09:30 PT), EU backup slot (16:00–17:30 CET)
- Week B: EU-friendly primary (10:00–11:30 CET), APAC evening backup (19:00–20:30 SGT)
- Week C: APAC primary (09:00–10:30 SGT), US evening backup (17:00–18:30 ET)

Please reply with which of the attached slots work for you, or share your preferred windows and I will coordinate. If it helps, we can tentatively hold Week B (EU primary) while we confirm who from your infra team will join.

Attachments: Medicore_Discovery_Notes.pdf (summary from today's call), Proposed_Time-Baton_Rotation.ics (3-week rotation candidate)

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
